vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: jisu-news
Version: 1.0.3

The skill is a standard implementation for fetching news via the JisuAPI service. The Python script (news.py) safely handles environment variables for the API key and uses the requests library to communicate with the official API endpoints (api.jisuapi.com). No evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt injection was found.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose (fetching news from JisuAPI), requests only the expected API key, and its code calls only the documented JisuAPI endpoints.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the implemented behavior: the code calls JisuAPI endpoints (/news/get and /news/channel) and requires JISU_API_KEY. No unrelated credentials or services are requested. Minor inconsistencies: SKILL.md references the script path 'skills/news/news.py' while the provided file is 'news.py' (path mismatch may break runtime invocation unless packaged accordingly). Also the code imports the Python 'requests' library but the skill does not declare this dependency.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to run the bundled script with JSON args or 'channels'; the script only reads the provided JSON, the JISU_API_KEY env var, and makes HTTPS calls to api.jisuapi.com. It does not attempt to read other files, other environment variables, or send data to third-party endpoints outside the documented API.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only + one script), so nothing is downloaded or written during installation. Risk is low. Note: runtime requires the 'requests' Python package but no install steps are provided to ensure it exists.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single API key (JISU_API_KEY) is required and it is appropriate for the declared purpose. No unrelated secrets or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no actions that modify other skills or global agent config. The skill does network calls when invoked but does not request elevated persistence or cross-skill access.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it claims: fetch news from JisuAPI. Before installing, consider: (1) Keep your JISU_API_KEY secret — this key grants access to your JisuAPI quota. (2) Ensure the runtime has Python and the 'requests' package available (the skill doesn't provide an install step). (3) Verify the script path used by your agent matches where the file is placed (SKILL.md path vs. actual file name). (4) The skill will make outbound HTTPS requests to api.jisuapi.com; if you restrict network egress or worry about autonomous network access, restrict autonomous invocation or review logs. (5) The API returns content from the public web — check copyright and source attribution if you will redistribute or publish results.
